scope: Pinned regular Standard 36.6.0.251952; not live legality; excludes Mercenaries and Battlegrounds
method: First-pass engineering triage of every missing card. Explicit ID review and printed-text-assisted families compared against current engine modules. Not executable rules, exhaustive generated dependency closure, a time estimate, or client-conformance certification.

C.label: Main effect familiar; generation dependencies block completion

D.label: Larger systems, unusual effects, or scope decisions

local_composition.label: Mostly existing mechanics
local_composition.reason: Existing draw, summon, choice, history, payload and trigger helpers cover the main behavior; add bounded glue and fixed dependencies, then validate.

held_progress.label: Held upgrades and turn counters
held_progress.reason: Extend physical-card progress and expiry hooks; verify threshold and turn-boundary semantics before reuse.

provenance.label: Card origin and hand-entry tracking
provenance.reason: Track physical starting-deck origin, copied-from-opponent identity and hand-entry time through every draw, copy, shuffle and control transition.

types.label: Type matching and Kindred selectors
types.reason: Extend multi-type matching, distinct selection and Kindred partner eligibility; verify ALL-type and overlapping-type cases.

modifiers.label: Damage, healing, costs and temporary control
modifiers.reason: Extend source-aware damage/healing replacement or ordered modifiers; existing flat buffs alone do not cover the rule.

payment.label: Health/Corpse payment
payment.reason: Add alternate payment to legal actions and resolution, including prevention, lethal payment and modifier interactions.

draw_events.label: Draw listeners
draw_events.reason: Add draw-event publication with burn, fatigue, copy and continuation semantics.

death_replay.label: Recorded deathrattle replay
death_replay.reason: Reuse captured death records but add nested resumable effect replay and listener/death ordering.

discover_events.label: Discover history and delayed rewards
discover_events.reason: Add Discover-specific events/counters and follow-up choice ownership; ordinary choices must not count as Discover.

cannoneers.label: Cannoneer shared firing rules
cannoneers.reason: Add a shared firing operation and permanent extra-shot modifier; include fixed Cannoneer token behavior.

leeches.label: Leech health stealing
leeches.reason: Implement the fixed Leech token and player-level steal amount; include lowest-health ties and hero/minion health semantics.

void_souls.label: Void Soul generation and upgrades
void_souls.reason: Review and implement the fixed Void Soul dependency plus persistent upgrade state; a random-generator member also needs its full pool.

leylines.label: Leyline scaling and persistent upgrades
leylines.reason: Implement the three related Leylines and shared upgrade/cost/repetition state; random-minion Leyline also needs pool closure.

animal_companions.label: Animal Companion replacement and count
animal_companions.reason: Centralize Companion generation and persistent substitutions/counts; replacement Beast pools must also be complete.

bonus.label: Random Bonus Effects
bonus.reason: Define the exact keyword pool, exclusions, stacking and steal/transfer rules; shared by multiple cards.

temporary.label: Temporary cards and attached hand effects
temporary.reason: Add temporary generated-card expiry and playable-hand-card grant semantics; generated pools remain separate dependencies.

either_side.label: Play onto either board
either_side.reason: Extend action encoding, board-space legality and controller-dependent Battlecries/deathrattles.

small_state.label: Bounded state/choice extensions
small_state.reason: A local feature extension is needed beyond composing current opcodes; inspect the card-specific explanation and generated dependencies.

combat.label: Forced attacks and combat interruption
combat.reason: Need an owner-correct resumable combat API, precombat interruption, retaliation, kill attribution and death/choice checkpoints.

autocast.label: Casting/replaying cards inside effects
autocast.reason: Need nested play frames, legal/random targets, counter/trigger timing and resumable repeated effects; damage-only substitutions are insufficient.

draw_cast.label: Casts/Summons When Drawn
draw_cast.reason: Need a resumable draw pipeline, automatic effect resolution/replacement draw, burned-card rules and correct summon controller.

deckbuilding.label: Setup, deckbuilding and hero replacement
deckbuilding.reason: Touches deck legality, initial state, starting hands/hero powers or attached special cards; cannot be implemented as a normal Battlecry.

unique.label: Custom or unusual persistent systems
unique.reason: Needs a dedicated state/action contract and generated effects; research/implementation effort is not established by a short card description.

scope.label: Noncombat simulation scope decisions
scope.reason: Decide explicitly whether emote/timer behavior is modeled or intentionally omitted in this ML simulator; do not silently count it as implemented.

rewind.label: Rewind and alternate outcomes
rewind.reason: Rollback/counterfactual outcomes, RNG and hidden-information handling need a shared contract.

shatter.label: Shatter and Advance
shatter.reason: Split/recombined card identity and Advance transformations need new hand/deck/action semantics.

herald.label: Herald and Deathwing upgrades
herald.reason: Implement Herald progress, Soldier generation and Deathwing upgrade dependencies together.

colossal.label: Colossal and appendages
colossal.reason: Implement appendage placement, lifecycle and component-specific effects; some also require forced attacks or spell repetition.

prepare.label: Prepare
prepare.reason: Implement shared Prepare action, discount/progress state and associated triggers; complex reward effects remain separate dependencies.

imbue.label: Imbue and upgraded hero powers
imbue.reason: Implement all affected hero-power upgrades and Imbue progress plus generated dependencies.

dark_gift.label: Dark Gifts
dark_gift.reason: Implement the complete Dark Gift effect pool and attached-state behavior; Discover variants also depend on generated-card pools.

dormant.label: Dormant and awakening
dormant.reason: Add inactive board entities, targeting/trigger suppression, wake timing and conditional awakening.

quests.label: Quests and rewards
quests.reason: Add quest slots/progress, event conditions and complete reward effects; each reward needs separate review.

generation.label: Global generation/Discover pool dependencies
generation.reason: Main effect often uses familiar operations, but exact pool eligibility and every possible generated card must work. No supported-only pool substitution. Additional card-specific conditions may still need local glue.
